Mia: Heads-up — launching a 2-week sprint to reweight MDF slabs across HW partners + cloud marketplace ahead of next QBR. Need quick decisions on priority buckets, contingency runway, and a small HW credits pilot. Who can join a 30m sync today? TL;DR below.

Jordan: I can make 3pm PT. Do we have the current slab usage numbers?

Samir: Posting quick snapshot now:
```
partner,allocated_mdf_usd,used_last_qtr_usd,requested_next_qtr_usd
CloudRange,500000,220000,400000
EdgeAI,300000,110000,250000
SysIntegrate,200000,190000,210000
MarketplacePool,150000,90000,180000
HardwarePilot,100000,30000,80000
```

Olivia: Thanks — CloudRange and EdgeAI show slack. Recommend shifting ~15% from Tier2 pool into Tier1 marketplace pilots to accelerate listings.

Mia: Sounds reasonable. We also need to reserve ~$200k for the HW credits pilot (to sweeten SI integrations). Can someone model 2 scenarios (conservative + aggressive)?

Jordan: I'll run a simple reallocation model and post results by EOD. Also tagging legal for any contract min-spend changes @legal-team.

Samir: :thumbsup: I'll draft partner impact notes (short blurbs) — highlighting fallback credits vs extended trial.

partner-bot: Reminder: QBR deck deadline in 3 days. Please upload final slides to /drive/Partnerships/QBR-Decks.

Mia: Plan for today: 1) sync at 3pm PT, 2) Jordan posts models by EOD, 3) finalize decision doc before EOD Friday. If you can't make 3pm ping me and I'll follow up.

Olivia: 3pm PT works. Proposed agenda: 1) allocation proposals 2) contingency triggers (utilization thresholds) 3) comms plan for partners 4) marketplace listing timing + tech enablement notes.

Jordan: Agenda LGTM. I'll share model link after run: https://drive.re/redwood/partner-reweights (placeholder).

Samir: I'll prepare a 2-slide outreach template for partners (offer + fallback), and include a quick FAQ for sales.

Mia: After sync we'll run a canary notify to the top-5 affected partners to gauge appetite. If partners push back we'll fallback to HW credits + shorter co-marketing windows.

Jordan: Noted. See you all 3pm PT. :rocket:
